( SELECT t1.LAYOUT_CODE AS layout_code, t1.TAB_CODE AS tab_code, t1.TAB_DESC AS tab_desc, t1.TAB_SEQ AS tab_seq, t1.TAB_GROUP AS tab_group, t1.BASE_TABLE AS base_table, t1.QUERY_SOURCE AS query_source, nvl( t1.ROW_COUNT, 0 ) AS row_count, nvl( t1.COLUMN_COUNT, 0 ) AS column_count, nvl( t1.FIELD_WIDTH, 120 ) AS field_width, t1.ENABLED_FLAG AS enabled_flag, t1.CREATED_BY AS created_by, t1.CREATION_DATE AS creation_date, t1.LAST_UPDATED_BY AS last_updated_by, t1.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS last_update_date, t1.CONFIGURABLE AS configurable, t1.REF_TAB_CODE AS ref_tab_code, nvl( t1.LABEL_WIDTH, 120 ) AS label_width, nvl( t1.MARGIN_TOP, 3 ) AS margin_top, nvl( t1.BOX_WIDTH, 1200 ) AS box_width, nvl( t1.SHOW_BOX, 'N' ) AS show_box, t1.PARENT_TAB_CODE AS parent_tab_code, t1.TAB_TYPE AS tab_type, t1.BASE_TABLE_PK AS base_table_pk, t1.PARENT_TABLE AS parent_table, t1.selected_flag AS selected_flag, lower(nvl((SELECT d.BASE_TABLE_PK FROM hls_doc_layout_tab d WHERE d.LAYOUT_CODE = t1.LAYOUT_CODE AND (d.ROOT_TREE_CODE = t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE OR t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT') AND d.BASE_TABLE = t1.PARENT_TABLE AND d.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and rownum=1 ), t1.BASE_TABLE_PK)) AS parent_base_table_pk, t1.TREE_CODE AS tree_code, t1.TREE_LEVEL AS tree_level, t1.TAB_REF_SCREEN AS tab_ref_screen, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.SETUP_WIDTH = 'MARGIN_WIDTH' ) THEN nvl( t1.MARGIN_WIDTH, 70 ) ELSE '' END ) AS margin_width, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.SETUP_WIDTH = 'ABSOLUTE_WIDTH' ) THEN nvl( t1.WIDTH, 300 ) ELSE '' END ) AS width, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.SETUP_HEIGHT = 'MARGIN_HEIGHT' ) THEN nvl( t1.MARGIN_HEIGHT, 70 ) ELSE '' END ) AS margin_height, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.SETUP_HEIGHT = 'ABSOLUTE_HEIGHT' ) THEN nvl( t1.HEIGHT, 200 ) ELSE '' END ) AS height, t1.REPEAT_OBJECT AS repeat_object, t1.REPEAT_BINDERTARGET_FLAG AS repeat_bindertarget_flag, t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE AS root_tree_code, ( CASE
WHEN ( t1.BASE_TABLE is null ) THEN 'N' WHEN ( t1.RECREATE_DS_FLAG = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE ( CASE
WHEN ( ( SELECT 1 FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hls_doc_layout_tab t WHERE ( ( t.LAYOUT_CODE = t1.LAYOUT_CODE ) AND ( t.BASE_TABLE = t1.BASE_TABLE ) AND ( t.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( ( t.ROOT_TREE_CODE IN ( 'TENANT', 'GUARANTEE' ) ) AND ( t.ROOT_TREE_CODE = t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE ) ) OR ( t.ROOT_TREE_CODE NOT IN ( 'TENANT', 'GUARANTEE' ) ) ) AND ( t.TAB_TYPE != 'GRID' ) AND ( t.TAB_SEQ < t1.TAB_SEQ ) AND ( t.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ) ) = 1 ) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ) END ) AS parent_tab_code_flag, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = '' ) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ) AS parent_table_flag, nvl( ( SELECT d.TAB_CODE FROM hls_doc_layout_tab d WHERE ( ( d.LAYOUT_CODE = t1.LAYOUT_CODE ) AND ( d.BASE_TABLE = nvl( t1.PARENT_TABLE, t1.BASE_TABLE ) ) AND ( d.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( d.ROOT_TREE_CODE = t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE ) OR ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) OR ( t1.BASE_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) ) AND ( d.TAB_SEQ = nvl( ( SELECT max( ht.TAB_SEQ ) FROM hls_doc_layout_tab ht WHERE ( ( ht.LAYOUT_CODE = t1.LAYOUT_CODE ) AND ( ht.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( ht.ROOT_TREE_CODE = t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE ) OR ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) OR ( t1.BASE_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) ) AND ( ht.BASE_TABLE = nvl( t1.PARENT_TABLE, t1.BASE_TABLE ) ) AND ( ht.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( ( ht.REF_TAB_CODE IS NOT NULL ) AND ( ht.TAB_TYPE != 'GRID' ) ) OR ( ht.REF_TAB_CODE is null ) ) AND ( ht.TAB_SEQ <= t1.TAB_SEQ ) AND ( ht.RECREATE_DS_FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ), ( SELECT min( ht.TAB_SEQ ) FROM hls_doc_layout_tab ht WHERE ( ( ht.LAYOUT_CODE = t1.LAYOUT_CODE ) AND ( ht.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( ht.ROOT_TREE_CODE = t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE ) OR ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) OR ( t1.BASE_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT' ) ) AND ( ht.BASE_TABLE = nvl( t1.PARENT_TABLE, t1.BASE_TABLE ) ) AND ( ht.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) AND ( ( ( ht.REF_TAB_CODE IS NOT NULL ) AND ( ht.TAB_TYPE != 'GRID' ) ) OR ( ht.REF_TAB_CODE is null ) ) ) ) ) ) AND ( d.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' ) ) ), t1.TAB_CODE ) AS parent_table_tab_code, t1.PARENT_LOADED_OBJECT AS parent_loaded_object, t1.ATTACHMENT_TAB_GROUP AS attachment_tab_group, t1.REPEAT_BINDNAME_OBJECT AS repeat_bindname_object, ( CASE
WHEN ( t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE = 'TENANT' ) THEN 'TENANT' WHEN ( ( t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE = 'GUARANTEE' ) AND ( ( t1.BASE_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT_BP' ) OR ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT_BP' ) ) ) THEN 'GUARANTOR' WHEN ( ( t1.ROOT_TREE_CODE = 'ACT_CTRLER' ) AND ( ( t1.BASE_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT_BP' ) OR ( t1.PARENT_TABLE = 'PRJ_PROJECT_BP' ) ) ) THEN 'GUARANTOR' END ) AS query_bp_category, nvl( t1.QUERY_ONLY, 'N' ) AS query_only, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.FETCHALL = 'Y' ) THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END ) AS fetchall, ( CASE WHEN ( t1.REF_V05 = 'Y' ) THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END ) AS navbar, t1.CHECK_BEFORE_DELETE_BM AS check_before_delete_bm, t1.CHECK_AFTER_SAVE_BM AS check_after_save_bm, t1.SWITCHCARD_VALUE AS switchcard_value, nvl( t1.RECREATE_DS_FLAG, 'N' ) AS recreate_ds_flag FROM hls_doc_layout_tab t1 ORDER BY t1.ENABLED_FLAG DESC, t1.TAB_SEQ )
